desc: Fifty targets in all, along with fifty 1" pasters to cover shot marks and extend the shooting life of your larger targets. There is a target for several shooting needs, including rifles, handguns, pistols and airguns. Pack includes: 5-8" bull's-eyes, 5- 5.5" bull's-eyes, 10-3" bull's-eyes, 30-2" bull's-eyes and 50-1" pasters. Targets can be adhered to the corrugated backer for convenient shooting fun. 5 sheets.
